description: Docker Desktop settings-store.json template with hardware acceleration disabled
note: If Docker Desktop still has DPI scaling issues after running fix-dpi-scaling.ps1, you may need to disable hardware acceleration.
instructions: 4. Add or modify the 'hardwareAcceleration' setting to false

settings.note: Setting hardwareAcceleration to false may help resolve DPI scaling issues on some systems

alternative_location: The settings file may also be located at: %LOCALAPPDATA%\Docker\settings.json
